# shoal_oidc_provider (Resource)

Single sign-on through an OpenID Connect provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google, Auth0, Keycloak, ...). Register `<endpoint>/v1/auth/callback` as the redirect URI in the provider. Maps to `/v1/oidc-providers/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shoal_oidc_provider" "okta" {
  name            = "okta"
  display_name    = "Sign in with Okta"
  issuer          = "https://acme.okta.com"
  client_id       = var.okta_client_id
  client_secret   = var.okta_client_secret
  groups_claim    = "groups"
  allowed_domains = ["acme.com"]
  default_role    = "viewer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client id.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer URL; discovery is read from `<issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
- `name` (String) Provider name, part of the login URL.

### Optional

- `allowed_domains` (Set of String) Only allow verified emails in these domains (empty: any).
- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Create users on first sign-in. Defaults to `true`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret (write-only on the server). Omit for public clients; PKCE is always used.
- `default_namespace` (String) Namespace for `default_role` (omit for a tenant-wide binding).
- `default_role` (String) Role bound to newly provisioned users.
- `display_name` (String) Button label on the sign-in page. Defaults to `name`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Show on the sign-in page. Defaults to `true`.
- `groups_claim` (String) ID token claim holding group names (e.g. `groups`); groups are synced on each sign-in.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes to request. Defaults to `["openid", "email", "profile"]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `login_url` (String) Sign-in URL template (`{tenant}` is the tenant slug).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shoal_oidc_provider.okta okta
```
